description: Central Province - Order made under Sec. 20 of the Regulations of the Passenger Transport Service Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Ediriweera Weerawardana) with his ministerial title and outlines detailed portfolio responsibilities (Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy and Housing and Construction). It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), meeting the criteria for Hybrid Gazette classification. The content involves the minister exercising powers vested in him to issue orders regarding passenger transport services, which combines personnel authority with specific administrative functions.
